title: Rudolf Hess's telepathy experiments and astrologically timed flight
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Rudolf Hess's telepathy experiments and astrologically timed flight, about 1941 onward at Germany / British prison, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> he believed he was in telepathic communication with his wife while he was in prison they ran telepathy experiments

plain: Rudolf Hess was a senior Nazi leader who flew to Britain in 1941 and was then held prisoner. An author named Peter Levenda, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says Hess's flight was timed by astrology, that Hess believed he was in telepathic contact with his wife from prison, and that telepathy experiments were run with him. If true, it would show occult beliefs shaping events at the top of wartime Germany.
